name: delivery-loop
description: Run unattended issue-to-merge delivery or continue a long-horizon repository objective without Codex Goal mode. Uses isolated worktrees, touch-scope leases, independent Elephant-Goldfish review, computed scoring, gated auto-merge, durable checkpoints, and bounded dead-loop recovery.
